initialWorkingTree: Included earlier uncommitted AUD-07 navigation changes and audit notes; superseded by this explicit product decision.
request: brrti fitur proyek kita hapus aja
status: IMPLEMENTED; automated checks complete; native migration QA pending
productDecision: Use Target -> Tahapan -> Tugas -> Hari Ini; no separate Project feature.

featureRemoval.removed: Three project screens, project components/hooks/entities/repository contracts/implementations and the old database project repository.
featureRemoval.navigation: Menu/Quick Add/web navigation no longer offer projects. Menu has its own placeholder tab; the initial visible tab remains Hari Ini.
featureRemoval.legacyRoutes: Hidden old list route redirects to Targets, old create route to Target creation, old project detail to its converted Target or the Target list if deleted.
featureRemoval.activeWrites: Stages/tasks only created for Targets; Agenda has no project creation input; task category PROJECT is retained in stored data but displayed as Target.

migration.rule: One old project becomes one separate Target. No existing Target is merged or deleted.
migration.category: Inherited from the former parent Target if present; otherwise category/pillar stay null (Umum).
migration.formerParent: The previous parent Target name is recorded in the new Target description; there is no active parent-project hierarchy.
migration.stages: Keep original IDs/order. Convert milestones into additional stages after existing stages; preserve old status/deadline in notes.
migration.tasks: Keep IDs, status, estimates, actual minutes and timestamps. Keep existing stage where present; preserve overlapping milestone context in notes. Otherwise attach to the converted milestone/Tugas stage.
migration.history: Daily priorities and focus sessions keep their task IDs; Agenda links move to the converted Target.
migration.atomicity: Startup saves/verifies a pre-conversion archive and rejects concurrent changes before a synchronous all-project transaction. Restore stages and converts inside the replacement transaction. FK, logical backup and backup size/row-limit checks must pass.
migration.journal: project_target_v1:<projectId> -> targetId in user_settings; prevents duplicates and resurrection after deletion.
migration.compatibility: Original projects/milestones and schema columns are retained as backup compatibility records only; their CRUD feature is deleted.
